audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. Completed-cycle, vacuum-constant and degree-zero conventions conflict; Stable degree-zero geometric formula and localization series disagree; Definition4.1 omits exceptional central term
limitations: Limitations: Journal PDF not independently compared; v2 only targeted native-agent comparison, not a complete second review.
Limitations: Supplement release date not independently established; metadata date does not establish publication; older notation not equated to v3.
Limitations: Spin ELSV, representation-theoretic character formulas and BKP foundations are cited dependencies, not independently reproved.
Limitations: No author code found or executed. Absence is not treated as a defect.
Limitations: No counterexample to a consistently repaired positive-degree correspondence or BKP theorem is claimed.

Limitations: Main controller UI observation remains attributed and the backend is not independently verified. Focused independent acceptance of all eight existing Problems is recorded; scientific_decision remains pending and human_reviews is empty. This is not a complete independent proof audit of the whole paper.
P1 — Completed-cycle, vacuum-constant and degree-zero conventions conflict — Counterevidence: v3 2^-g correction has consistent nonempty examples; no claim it is itself wrong.

P1 — Completed-cycle, vacuum-constant and degree-zero conventions conflict — Counterevidence: The v3 correction2^-g has valid nonempty small cases; the v2 coefficient for c3 is different and was not substituted. Proposition5.4 explicitly excludes zero-degree components and is not itself disproved. No consistently repaired positive-degree correspondence is refuted.
P2 — Stable degree-zero geometric formula and localization series disagree — Counterevidence: Positive-degree connected concavity remains applicable; specialized odd-edge signs cancel.

P2 — Stable degree-zero geometric formula and localization series disagree — Counterevidence: Positive-degree connected concavity holds; constant maps have H0 nonzero and R1 rankg instead ofg+d-1. The general-k sign error does not disprove the specialized k1,alpha=-1/2 odd-edge product, whose sign changes cancel and whose even-edge terms vanish. The actual cosection-localized zero-degree invariant is not inferred merely from either conflicting series.

P3 — Definition4.1 omits exceptional central term — Counterevidence: Adding a scalar leaves commutators unchanged; it changes the vacuum expectations used in the Hodge/GW proof. Two coefficient checks do not constitute an all-genus repair or a proof of all central lifts.

P4 — Dimension and connectedness invalidate the literal principal statements — Counterevidence: Theorem 5.3 already uses disconnected invariants and the body uses the correct dimension condition. This identifies the intended correction without validating the literal main statement.

P4 — Dimension and connectedness invalidate the literal principal statements — Counterevidence: Theorem5.3 already has the proper disconnected marker, and the body uses the correct dimension condition. No counterexample to that corrected disconnected theorem is established; the main printed statement remains false in its stated convention.

P5 — Operator centering and conjugation signs disagree with downstream use — Counterevidence: The actual Proposition4.2 calculation uses the centered exponentl-k/2, and the Theorem4.7 proof uses the correct inverse exponential. The retained script truly asserts the parity derivative but only prints the conjugation numbers; the latter was independently verified analytically, not by that script.
P6 — Full parity projection is not a Lie homomorphism — Counterevidence: No counterexample to Prop4.5 commutator supplied; actual Z=t S²/(2u) respected.

P6 — Full parity projection is not a Lie homomorphism — Counterevidence: For the anti-automorphism tau(S)=-S,tau(H)=-H, the actual D,Dtilde,X,E are anti-invariant, and the odd sector is a Lie subalgebra. The formal ODE W'=WE/t with W(0)=1 implies tau(W)=W^-1 when defined, so conjugation preserves this restricted subalgebra. No counterexample to Proposition4.5's commutator is claimed.
P7 — One-point recurrence and V energy are incorrect — Counterevidence: Correct supplement and Cor5.6 confirm local repair; Prop5.4 not refuted.

P7 — One-point recurrence and V energy are incorrect — Counterevidence: The unchanged historical script really constructs occupation states and asserts all norms, strict-partition weights, corrected recurrences and Table1 rows for d1..8. The d1..3 computed spectral weights support the analytic multipoint formulas, but are not a programmatic proof for arbitrary point count or geometry. Corollary5.6 and the supplement support the corrected local formulas.

P8 — The conditional extension relies on an undefined positive form and unproved Gram identification — Counterevidence: The finite-dimensional positive-isometry conclusion is valid and a repair route may exist. No counterexample to TheoremE or ConjectureD is established.

P8 — The conditional extension relies on an undefined positive form and unproved Gram identification — Counterevidence: A unitriangular isometry of a positive finite-dimensional form is indeed the identity; its basis need not already be orthonormal. That valid algebraic fact does not construct the missing pairing or justify the Hurwitz Gram identity. No counterexample to conditional TheoremE or ConjectureD is supplied.
Limitations: Main controller UI observation is attributed; backend not independently verified; initial review is not independent acceptance.
The finding applies to the exact reviewed source version and inspected scope; uninspected publication versions are not adjudicated.
The report retains counterevidence and unresolved questions. Publication does not repeat scientific review.
